settings.heading: Burrows Jewellers
settings.text:
We are a trusted and knowledgeable jeweller located in Mildura, Victoria, providing our local community with quality, unique jewellery and watches.

We have a wealth of information that we will use to help you select the perfect piece of jewellery. Come in and talk to us about all of your jewellery needs today.

For more than 30 years, the Burrows family has cared for its customers, offering them top quality services and brands to suit all individuals and styles and proudly continues from one generation to the next.

settings.heading: Contact Us Today!
settings.text: To book an appointment to discuss a custom design, remake or remodel please provide a brief of what you envision and we'll be in touch to arrange an appointment.
